11.description: Rezoning land in Brighton near Traeger Manor and Asokan Avenue from future urban development to R1A and R2 districts will allow for one to four-unit residential dwellings.

chips.text: Property owners within 150 meters of the rezoned land were notified.
No public correspondence or concerns were received by administration.

12.description: Council approved an amendment to the St. John's Anglican Cathedral heritage bylaw, allowing the church to subdivide and sell surplus land while preserving the main building's heritage status.

chips.text: No public objections were received regarding the bylaw amendment.

13.description: The city will lease 1.061 acres of Grace Adam Metawewinihk Park to Greater Saskatoon Catholic Schools for St. Mary's Wellness and Education Centre to create a secure outdoor area for student safety. The city will pay $8,000 for site work.

chips.text: Students at St. Mary's Wellness and Education Centre for safety.
Atypical lease allows fencing and exclusive school use of municipal reserve.
Community consultation confirmed need for enhanced student safety.
City will inform Ministry of Education about costs for similar future cases.
